title: Expose site and section search targets through CLI and MCP
description: Investigate whether publication-level and section-linked concepts already provide intended search targets and how to distinguish explicit prioritization, aliases, inherited scope, overrides and no targets without assuming every concept is a target. Provide aligned read-only CLI and MCP interfaces backed by shared logic that list effective targets for the site and a selected section, show source/provenance and support machine-readable output. Specify how agents and review use this information; do not create a duplicate store without evidence.
